verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a scheduling platform with an API, MCP server and CLI. The evidence documents only single-item endpoints: create, reschedule, event types, schedules and webhooks. Nothing shows a batch or bulk endpoint, and recurring-booking creation and multi-user availability queries are adjacent features, not bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
